title: Teacher-written information text 'A Day in Pompeii'

intro: Lesson 94: Life in Pompeii before the eruption (VIPERS). Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Teacher-written information text for TGA
paras: Pompeii was a busy Roman town near the Bay of Naples. Its streets were paved with large stones, and raised stepping stones let people cross without stepping in the mud. Bakers made round loaves in big stone ovens. In the forum, people bought food, met friends and heard the news. Water flowed to public fountains through pipes. Behind the town rose a green mountain, Vesuvius. Few people knew it was a volcano.

model.title: How did people cross the streets without stepping in mud?

parts.text: Scan: 'raised stepping stones let people cross'

questions.q: Core: answer six VIPERS questions on 'A Day in Pompeii'
Extend: write a sentence describing the forum using two facts
questions.a: For example: The forum was busy with people buying food and sharing news.

questions.q: Stretch: what would you miss most from modern life in Pompeii? Explain
'Few people knew it was a volcano.' What does this suggest?
questions.a: A) People did not expect danger. If they did not know it was a volcano, they would not expect an eruption.
